title: kithd: owner senderId is 'self', spec says accountId
description: Found during KITH-1ln3. kithd serializes SenderId::Owner as the wire string 'self' (crate-jmap-chat-types at pinned rev 24f15707). draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00 Message.senderId: 'The accountId for owner-composed messages'; Terminology: a client-facing reference to the owner carries the accountId. kith-tui now identifies own messages by accountId (KITH-1ln3.1), so against kithd its own messages display under the raw id 'self' until kithd (or the crate-jmap pin) is updated.
